text: Good service, the doctor is cheerful and friendly, and they accept social security insurance.

I had my teeth cleaned by the dentist and experienced no tooth sensitivity at all, unlike when I usually experience a lot of sensitivity elsewhere – I don't know why. The dentist did a great job, the cleaning was thorough, and they gave good advice on dental care. I highly recommend them.

I've been to this dental clinic about 2-3 times, but my most recent visit was very disappointing. Before going, I clearly stated the price, and I even asked three times about the maximum cost because I have a limited budget. However, after the procedure, they charged me an extra 500 baht.

The doctor is very kind and patient. The treatment plan was excellent. Besides the affordable price, the doctor also helped take care of my dental health and gave me advice. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for one. 🙏🏻
-Convenient location, with parking available at Seri Market (behind the clinic) for 10 baht per hour.

The dentist did a great job. The procedure was well-planned, with minimal tooth loss; the result is incredibly smooth and visible immediately after completion. It's been three months now, and there's no damage; it still looks as good as ever.

Wow! I've never met a dentist who could remove tartar so gently and softly before ❤️ Where have I been all this time? 😍 The dentist is incredibly kind. I even had to ask if he used to be a pediatrician! He's as calm as a hundred rivers... I highly recommend him! 🍀🌺🍀🌺 …

The best dentist in thailand!! Such a kind man - who helped me with some night guards, very affordable prices. (Aka cheap!!)

I will definitely come back here.
The doctor is experienced, the clinic has modern equipment, and is spiritually upright. You can park at the Seri Village Market or at Big C and walk across.
The doctor was very kind and gave great advice. I was very impressed.

text: I'm here to confirm again! The doctor is excellent and very knowledgeable. If you have any questions, the doctor answers thoroughly without getting annoyed or irritated. They are a kind, calm, and polite person. I had a filling done here, and when I got home, I felt it was too high. The next day, I went to see the doctor, and they fixed it for free. The doctor said that if the filling falls out within 3 months, I can come back for a free refill. Honestly, I'd give them 10 stars, but there are only 5! 555 😍😍😍

We were getting braces at another clinic, but tonight a wire came loose around 8 PM, and we have to travel out of town early the next morning. Luckily, we found this clinic. Even though they were about to close, the doctor saw us come in …

I've been a regular customer at this dental clinic for over ten years. The dentist is kind and gives excellent advice about oral health. With over 20 years of experience, they pay attention to every detail and are very gentle – you barely feel anything.
The equipment is of high quality, and the prices are reasonable.
